quotes.name: Bonepicker Skirge
quotes.flavor: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.

quotes.name: Hellkite Whelp
quotes.flavor:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler

quotes.name: Boreal Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"More than snow falls from the Boreal skies."
—Arkin Egilsson, skycaptain

quotes.name: Noxious Revival
quotes.flavor:
"Dead or alive, my creations are stronger than Jin-Gitaxias's septic minions."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

quotes.name: Treasure Cruise
quotes.flavor: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

quotes.name: Gary Clone
quotes.flavor: "Gary!"

quotes.name: Azorius Keyrune
quotes.flavor:
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law."
—Isperia

quotes.name: Bloodtithe Collector
quotes.flavor: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

quotes.name: Silverbluff Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to genius is forged in creativity.

quotes.name: Praetor's Grasp
quotes.flavor: "The throne brings you here? It seats only one."

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Pensive Professor
quotes.flavor: "To the patient mind, no problem is unsolvable."

quotes.name: Tempest Djinn
quotes.flavor: The first to arrive on Dominaria from their distant home, the marids are the oldest tribe of djinn and the most respected by storm and sea.

quotes.name: Velvetwing Butterflies // Gaze in Wonder
quotes.flavor: Bilbo's eyes were nearly blinded by the light. He could only hold on and blink at the sight of them.

quotes.name: Screeching Skaab
quotes.flavor: Its screeching is the sound of you losing your mind.

quotes.name: Keeper of the Sacred Word
quotes.flavor: This is not a subliminal message.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Compulsive Research
quotes.flavor: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

quotes.name: Flowstone Slide
quotes.flavor: It may look like soil, but its nature is malice.

quotes.name: Maalfeld Twins
quotes.flavor:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Ajani's Chosen
quotes.flavor: "United, our roar will level mountains."

quotes.name: Crystalline Sliver
quotes.flavor: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

quotes.name: Anaba Shaman
quotes.flavor: Just try taking *this* bull by the horns.

quotes.name: Reckless Amplimancer
quotes.flavor: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"

quotes.name: Meditate
quotes.flavor:
"Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Vengeful Creeper
quotes.flavor: Seeking intact evidence in the Rubblebelt is a fool's errand.

quotes.name: Tanglespan Lookout
quotes.flavor: "The trolls have your scent, traveler. Hurry on, and let me take care of them."

quotes.name: Soldevi Sage
quotes.flavor:
"Our underground archives grow daily, as our excavators and sages alike dig to uncover hidden wonders."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Thrashing Brontodon
quotes.flavor: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

quotes.name: Seer's Lantern
quotes.flavor: A light to bring hope in dark times.

quotes.name: Saruman the White
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Sauron's victory is at hand; and there will be rich reward for those who aided it."

quotes.name: Imposing Vantasaur
quotes.flavor: Raugrin's coastline can be quite beautiful, as long as you avoid the volcanic dinosaurs, the sea dinosaurs, and the roaming beach dinosaurs.

quotes.name: Make a Stand
quotes.flavor: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Crush Underfoot
quotes.flavor:
Five-toed grave
—Kithkin phrase meaning "a giant's footprint"

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Heartfire
quotes.flavor: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.

quotes.name: Intrepid Tenderfoot
quotes.flavor: Narix felt their molt coming. Before taking a new form, they had to find what Evendo required of them.

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor:
"We're capable of the most incredible change. We can evolve while still staying true to who we are. We can honor who we've been and choose who we want to be next."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Leonardo's Technique
quotes.flavor: "We Turtles don't know the meaning of the word defeat."

quotes.name: Potioner's Trove
quotes.flavor: The shops of Ribtruss Town sell anything that can be gathered within Titan's Grave. Just don't ask where they acquired their goods.

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elves
quotes.flavor: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

quotes.name: Jungle Barrier
quotes.flavor: A massive pull of mana caused all of Dominaria to pause—Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

quotes.name: Zealous Display
quotes.flavor: The Sunstar Free Company is not swayed by profit. Sunstar is their faith, the prism through which they cast light across Sothera.

quotes.name: Aether Snap
quotes.flavor:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

quotes.name: Unsparing Boltcaster
quotes.flavor: Zurgo valued those who took initiative.

quotes.name: Spellgorger Weird
quotes.flavor: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

quotes.name: Life Insurance
quotes.flavor: All the money in the world won't buy back a pulse.

quotes.name: Angelic Page
quotes.flavor: If only every message were as perfect as its messenger.

quotes.name: Agent Venom
quotes.flavor: Wounded in action, Corporal Thompson was offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

quotes.name: Quag Sickness
quotes.flavor: The dread gases didn't kill Farbid. But as he lay in the muck, miserable and helpless, watching ghouls and rats advance on him, he wished they had.

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor: His victims don't have time to feel despair.

quotes.name: Reckless Spite
quotes.flavor:
"Death is such an exquisite sensation."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"If the populace fears our authority, then I'd say we have an appropriately sensible populace."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Crawlspace
quotes.flavor: The goblins did not understand their attraction to the mana rig. They simply knew it was where they belonged.

quotes.name: Loamcrafter Faun
quotes.flavor: "Give me just a moment. I need to grow us a new bridge."

quotes.name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
quotes.flavor:
"The guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

quotes.name: Join Shields
quotes.flavor: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."

quotes.name: Mathas, Fiend Seeker
quotes.flavor: "All will know of your crimes."

quotes.name: Rampaging War Mammoth
quotes.flavor: The Mûmakil of Harad were great beasts, like moving houses, capable of dragging huge towers and engines to war.

quotes.name: Memory Lapse
quotes.flavor:
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?"
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

quotes.name: Wake the Past
quotes.flavor: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

quotes.name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
quotes.flavor: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

quotes.name: Night's Whisper
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

quotes.name: Phyrexian Battleflies
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

quotes.name: Blightning
quotes.flavor: In the spirit of inquiry, Tibalt applied a battery of agony spells. They yielded nothing on the vampire's whereabouts, but the screams were reward enough.

quotes.name: Teferi's Tutelage
quotes.flavor: "Tarassel's sixth law of temporal recursion is easy to understand as long as you know the first seven."

quotes.name: Rest in Peace
quotes.flavor:
"Requiescat in pace."
—Ezio Auditore

quotes.name: Enlisted Wurm
quotes.flavor: A match for any army—even its own.

quotes.name: Glory-Bound Initiate
quotes.flavor:
"Fly as an arrow through the trials, and never waver in your course."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

quotes.name: Moonlight Bargain
quotes.flavor: At every fifth full moon, the Moon Market convenes to peddle Ravnica's most forbidden wares.

quotes.name: Weary Prisoner // Wrathful Jailbreaker
quotes.flavor: "And now I'm coming for you!"

quotes.name: Pulse of Murasa
quotes.flavor: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

quotes.name: Swinging Ship
quotes.flavor:
"I feel just like Kari Zev! Ragavan, set a course for Lathnu!"
—Vorthos, Steward of Myth

quotes.name: Harmonic Prodigy
quotes.flavor: "Why would I deprive the crowd of an encore?"

quotes.name: Soltari Lancer
quotes.flavor:
"In times of war the victors rarely save their best for last."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

quotes.name: Hulkling, Burgeoning Bruiser
quotes.flavor: "We all named ourselves after the original Avengers. I picked the Hulk. Be honest. Wouldn't you?"

quotes.name: Incurable Ogre
quotes.flavor: Each mutation causes the incurables to look vastly different from one another. They are left with only one thing in common: their insatiable lust for the slaughter.

quotes.name: Strix Lookout
quotes.flavor: Wise. Watchful. Fashionable.

quotes.name: Veteran Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

quotes.name: Deranged Assistant
quotes.flavor: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

quotes.name: Famine
quotes.flavor:
"Better to starve to death than be bored to death."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Paladin of Predation
quotes.flavor: The strategies and politics of the Vicious Swarm are as subtle as Vorinclex himself.

quotes.name: Assembled Alphas
quotes.flavor: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

quotes.name: Fresh Meat
quotes.flavor: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: He wastes his amazing talents on proving how amazing he really is.

quotes.name: Kill Shot
quotes.flavor:
"In the assassination trade, no one lives to make more than one mistake."
—Anhelo, the Painter

quotes.name: Will, Scion of Peace
quotes.flavor: "It's easy to cry 'For glory!' and charge those who disagree with you. But it takes finesse to turn enemies into allies rather than corpses."

quotes.name: Voice of Many
quotes.flavor: His words echo every roar, screech, and howl of the wilds.

quotes.name: Sedge Troll
quotes.flavor: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

quotes.name: Elvish Champion
quotes.flavor:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

quotes.name: Copy Enchantment
quotes.flavor: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

quotes.name: Harmless Offering
quotes.flavor: "Such an adorable face!"

quotes.name: Dagger Caster
quotes.flavor: "Keep coming. I have knives enough for everyone."

quotes.name: Path of Ancestry
quotes.flavor:
"It's the TARDIS. It's my home! Or, at least it has been for a considerable number of years."
—The Second Doctor

quotes.name: Burrog Banemaker
quotes.flavor: In most colleges, Erren's poisonous skin would have made them a pariah. In Witherbloom, they were one of the most popular students on campus.

quotes.name: Tooth, Claw, and Tail
quotes.flavor: "Silence your wailing. This is but a taste of the destruction my pets have in store."

quotes.name: Haunted Fengraf
quotes.flavor: A ghoulcaller's playground.

quotes.name: Wing Splicer
quotes.flavor: "Progress is our great inheritance, perfection our ultimate destination."

quotes.name: Mana Drain
quotes.flavor: Enthusiasm is no match for preparation.

quotes.name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
quotes.flavor: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

quotes.name: Sacred Ground
quotes.flavor:
"That which knows itself cannot be shaped to another's will."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Samut, Voice of Dissent
quotes.flavor: "Hello. My name is Inigo Montoya. You killed my father. Prepare to die."

quotes.name: Innocent Blood
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

quotes.name: Fiery Fall
quotes.flavor: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

quotes.name: Tendrils of Agony
quotes.flavor:
Eternal Weekend
Legacy Championship 2025

quotes.name: Vona, Butcher of Magan
quotes.flavor: "For four hundred years, I have led armies of conquest. These lands hold nothing that can stand against me."

quotes.name: Sword of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

quotes.name: Roaring Primadox
quotes.flavor:
"They're easy enough to find. Question is, are you sure you want to find one?"
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

quotes.name: Lightning Axe
quotes.flavor:
"A gargoyle's meat can be carved with an ordinary cleaver, but for its petrous hide . . ."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

quotes.name: Nevinyrral's Disk
quotes.flavor: Nevinyrral's final act of spite was to make sure all of his magic was destroyed along with him.

quotes.name: Cathars' Crusade
quotes.flavor: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

quotes.name: Reito Lantern
quotes.flavor: Lanterns carved from the mystic stones of the Reito Mines were said to light the way of lost souls.

quotes.name: Dragonskull Summit
quotes.flavor: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

quotes.name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
quotes.flavor: A force as voracious as time itself.

quotes.name: Animate Wall
quotes.flavor:
"When you have been bitten with fangs of granite, you start to long for the ivory sabers of tigers."
—Norin the Wary

quotes.name: Orcish Artillery
quotes.flavor: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

quotes.name: Zo-Zu the Punisher
quotes.flavor:
"He can cause a lot of pain and do it with no fuss. That's all good, but I just wish he didn't do it to us!"
—Ku-Ku, akki poet

quotes.name: Talisman of Curiosity
quotes.flavor:
"This place has so many secrets to yield."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Ironclaw Orcs
quotes.flavor: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

quotes.name: Sylvan Caryatid
quotes.flavor: Those who enter the copse never leave. They find peace there and take root, becoming part of the ever-growing grove.

quotes.name: Azorius Charm
quotes.flavor:
"The rules of logic and order have already made the choice for you."
—Isperia

quotes.name: Zalto, Fire Giant Duke
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.

quotes.name: Blazing Archon
quotes.flavor:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

quotes.name: Mana Geode
quotes.flavor:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai

quotes.name: Protector of the Crown
quotes.flavor: "I gladly offer my weapon and my life to the glory of my sovereign."

quotes.name: Rapid Hybridization
quotes.flavor:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

quotes.name: Stonewood Invoker
quotes.flavor: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Rohirrim Lancer
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Dire deeds awake, dark is it eastward. Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!"
—Théoden

quotes.name: Reinforcements
quotes.flavor:
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords."
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Craven Hulk
quotes.flavor: Abandoned at birth, the giant was raised by goats. Ironically, it grew up to be the most cautious member of the herd.

quotes.name: Amass the Components
quotes.flavor: "I knew I'd find a use for all that newt spittle!"

quotes.name: Fit of Rage
quotes.flavor:
"Anger is fleeting; remorse is eternal."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Fulminator Mage
quotes.flavor:
"Unsafe Terrain Ahead—Turn Back"
—Sign near the former location of Pyrtagh Cairn

quotes.name: Undead Augur
quotes.flavor:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

quotes.name: Pinkie Pie
quotes.flavor: "Hey, you know what this calls for? A party!"

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"Una vez vi a un trasgo gritándole a una tormenta eléctrica. Perdió la discusión bastante rápido."
—Mago errante

quotes.name: Fists of Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

quotes.name: Delighted Halfling
quotes.flavor: Bilbo's return was quite unexpected, met with confusion and worry but also wonder and awe.

quotes.name: Behold the Unspeakable // Vision of the Unspeakable
quotes.flavor: Even as her students' minds succumbed to madness, Azami's obsession with the kami of forbidden knowledge only grew.

quotes.name: Tar Snare
quotes.flavor: The amorphous, magically animated residue known as the Fathom Sludge lurks in the Hagra Cistern, attacking its prey with pseudopods and dragging it down to be digested.

quotes.name: Shared Roots
quotes.flavor:
"Awed by the strength of their love, the Dawn Prince bound them together for eternity, and around them a great forest grew."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Broodmate Dragon
quotes.flavor: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter—and were promptly eaten by its diving mate.

quotes.name: Disfigure
quotes.flavor: With a snap of metal like a strike of lightning, the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.

quotes.name: Deadly Dispute
quotes.flavor: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

quotes.name: Shrivel
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever killed insects nibbling at your crops? I think that's what the Eldrazi believe they're doing to us."
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

quotes.name: Peace of Mind
quotes.flavor:
"What can a peasant get for free that an emperor can never buy?"
—Dal riddle

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Deviant Glee
quotes.flavor: "You just need the right incentive to fulfill my dreams."

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Elite Guard
quotes.flavor: The winged helms of the guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.

quotes.name: Ivy Lane Denizen
quotes.flavor: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

quotes.name: Wasteland Viper
quotes.flavor:
"The Gruul embrace all things poisonous and living in the cracks of society."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

quotes.name: Granite Shard
quotes.flavor: It's a piece of a world the goblins have never seen but would dearly like to blow up.

quotes.name: Mesa Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

quotes.name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
quotes.flavor: "How about a three-piece combo of Hi-Potion, Ether, and Phoenix Pinion for 444 Gil?"

quotes.name: Whispers of the Muse
quotes.flavor:
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Riddlesmith
quotes.flavor: The Neurok see the artificer as an archaeologist, clearing away falsehoods to see the truth hidden beneath.

quotes.name: Selfless Spirit
quotes.flavor: "There is always more to give."

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.flavor: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

quotes.name: Identity Crisis
quotes.flavor:
"To join our ranks, one must be pure. To be pure, one must be blessed by etherium. To be blessed, one must forget oneself."
—Ethersworn prayer

quotes.name: Screaming Nemesis
quotes.flavor: She sees the faces of those who wronged her in everyone she encounters.

quotes.name: Withering Torment
quotes.flavor: Each spindrell is the lingering consciousness of a survivor consumed by cellarspawn—a ragged, drifting remnant pulsing with constant psychic agony.

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Vineglimmer Snarl
quotes.flavor:
"It has strange properties, a Metebelis crystal. It can affect the mind."
—The Third Doctor

quotes.name: Illusory Angel
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, she is made of pure belief—but I hardly see why that makes her unique."
—Reith, master illusionist

quotes.name: Highway Robbery
quotes.flavor: The fires weren't even out before the backstabbing began.

quotes.name: Kor Castigator
quotes.flavor:
"He told us not to worry, and he walked into the cavern. The swirling mass of Eldrazi parted to admit him, then closed in his wake."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

quotes.name: Wandering Goblins
quotes.flavor: Tired of waiting for a dragon to eat them, some hardy goblins struck out to become meals for the unknown.

quotes.name: Hand That Feeds
quotes.flavor: In the darkness, Lana reached for Shay's hand and squeezed it for comfort. Then she heard Shay call to her from the next room.

quotes.name: Harmonized Crescendo
quotes.flavor: A song can unite quicker than a sword can divide.

quotes.name: Erase
quotes.flavor: Perception is more pleasing than truth.

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Smother
quotes.flavor:
"I can't hear them scream, but at least I don't have to listen to them beg."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Suntail Hawk
quotes.flavor: Its eye the glaring sun, its cry the keening wind.

quotes.name: Maddening Hex
quotes.flavor: Much more painful than mere regret.

quotes.name: Wild Wasteland
quotes.flavor: Some things in the wasteland are best left unexplained.

quotes.name: Street Savvy
quotes.flavor: "It takes more than swift feet and dark shadows to slip by me unnoticed."

quotes.name: Raiyuu, Storm's Edge
quotes.flavor: "The tempest is the only ally I need."

quotes.name: Dragonlord's Servant
quotes.flavor: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

quotes.name: Flame Jab
quotes.flavor:
"Fire's out. Should be safe now."
—Gnarltrunk

quotes.name: Arashin Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

quotes.name: Sokka, Bold Boomeranger
quotes.flavor: "I'm just a guy with a boomerang!"

quotes.name: Panther Warriors
quotes.flavor: The dogs of war are nothing compared to the cats.

quotes.name: Sylvan Ranger
quotes.flavor: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

quotes.name: Enthralling Victor
quotes.flavor: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

quotes.name: Timely Ward
quotes.flavor: Behind every general who leads from the front is a nervous mage with a spell at the ready.

quotes.name: Bloodthorn Taunter
quotes.flavor: Naya's celebrants stoke the gargantuans into a rage, loosing a tide of muscle with the precision of an arrow.

quotes.name: Mental Agony
quotes.flavor: "His mind is feeble. Feed him to the bats."

quotes.name: Dragon Blood
quotes.flavor: Fire in the blood, fire in the belly.

quotes.name: Drana's Emissary
quotes.flavor: "The taste of freedom is sweeter than blood."

quotes.name: Subjugate the Hobbits
quotes.flavor:
"This is worse than Mordor! Much worse, in a way. It comes home to you, as they say, because it is a home, and you remember it before it was all ruined."
—Sam

quotes.name: Cut of the Profits
quotes.flavor: Everybody is worth their weight in gold.

quotes.name: Netherborn Altar
quotes.flavor: It is spoken of only in whispers, visited only by the desperate.

quotes.name: Rubblebelt Braggart
quotes.flavor: "I did it! Double—no, triple homicide! In a building I set on fire. Yep, all me."

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor: "The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day. But you are not here to see it."

quotes.name: Divine Offering
quotes.flavor: D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact. The fight was getting ugly.

quotes.name: Search the Premises
quotes.flavor: Mood: Determined to find evidence of wrongdoing.

quotes.name: Ilysian Caryatid
quotes.flavor: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

quotes.name: Syphon Mind
quotes.flavor: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

quotes.name: Nomad Mythmaker
quotes.flavor: Nomads weave tales thicker than tapestries.

quotes.name: Bloodlust Inciter
quotes.flavor: "To victory! To glory! To eternity!"

quotes.name: Temporal Adept
quotes.flavor:
"If yesterday was two days ago tomorrow, will the day after tomorrow be today or yesterday?"
—Temporal Manipulation 101 final exam, Tolarian Academy

quotes.name: Perimeter Sergeant
quotes.flavor: "Get in there, soldier! I want a pelt on my wall before lunch!"

quotes.name: Fog Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"It's the perfect sentry. Those who should pass can go right through it."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Model of Unity
quotes.flavor:
"Rivendell is a perfect house, whether you like food or sleep or storytelling or singing, or a pleasant mixture of them all."
—Bilbo

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Death in the Family
quotes.flavor: Often enemies, always brothers . . . till the end.

quotes.name: Alluring Siren
quotes.flavor:
"The ground polluted floats with human gore,
And human carnage taints the dreadful shore
Fly swift the dangerous coast: let every ear
Be stopp'd against the song! 'tis death to hear!"
—Homer, *The Odyssey*, trans. Pope

quotes.name: Anguished Unmaking
quotes.flavor: There was a roar and a great confusion of noise. Fires leaped up and licked the roof. The throbbing grew to a great tumult, and the Mountain shook.

quotes.name: Mothdust Changeling
quotes.flavor:
"Ever seen a changeling fly into a lantern?"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

quotes.name: Blufferfish
quotes.flavor: Lying to a fish is such an unthinkable act, most planets don't even have a law against it.

quotes.name: Thriving Heath
quotes.flavor: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

quotes.name: Skirsdag Cultist
quotes.flavor: "Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"

quotes.name: Highland Game
quotes.flavor:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon her head. This one hears the whispers."
—Chianul, at the weaving of Arel

quotes.name: Endless Cockroaches
quotes.flavor: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.

quotes.name: Prakhata Pillar-Bug
quotes.flavor: Not a mote of dust escapes the dutiful cleaners that keep the exclusive Prakhata Club immaculate.

quotes.name: Wildheart Invoker
quotes.flavor:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Wistful Selkie
quotes.flavor: Selkies call to a sea they never swam, in a tongue they never spoke, with a song they never learned.

quotes.name: Prodigal Pyromancer
quotes.flavor: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

quotes.name: Inspiring Overseer
quotes.flavor:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

quotes.name: Elite Vanguard
quotes.flavor: The vanguard is skilled at waging war alone. The enemy is often defeated before its reinforcements reach the front.

quotes.name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
quotes.flavor: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

quotes.name: Loyal Apprentice
quotes.flavor: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

quotes.name: Gush
quotes.flavor: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: Hand in hand, they sowed the seeds, and the battered earth began to flourish once again.

quotes.name: Azure Fleet Admiral
quotes.flavor:
"Your concern for my safety is touching, but as long as your gunners remain reliably erratic, I see no reason to change course."
—Admiral Yelise, to Commodore Axurik

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor:
"The so-called barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

quotes.name: Uugguu, the Omniplasm
quotes.flavor: It doesn't hunt. It doesn't hunger. It simply waits as all oozes eventually find their way back to it.

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor:
"Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living."
—Auron

quotes.name: Battle of Wits
quotes.flavor: There is no loftier ambition than the pursuit of knowledge.

quotes.name: Alaborn Musketeer
quotes.flavor: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

quotes.name: Clot Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"One would think I would be accustomed to unexpected returns."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Sanguine Evangelist
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: "Fang-brethren, we feed together."

quotes.name: Angelic Purge
quotes.flavor: "We must save you from yourselves."

quotes.name: Altar's Reap
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

quotes.name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
quotes.flavor: "So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar."

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
quotes.flavor: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.

quotes.name: Paradise Plume
quotes.flavor: A last wisp of paradise in a fallen world.

quotes.name: Raffine's Informant
quotes.flavor: "I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?"

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor: The priest cast Xantcha to the ground. "It is defective. We must scrap it."

quotes.name: Sea Serpent
quotes.flavor: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

quotes.name: Argivian Restoration
quotes.flavor:
"The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Inferno Jet
quotes.flavor: "When the whole world is crazy, it's important to find something you can rely on."

quotes.name: Encroaching Wastes
quotes.flavor: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.flavor: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

quotes.name: Rout
quotes.flavor:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Loyal Gyrfalcon
quotes.flavor: It's tethered not to keep it from fleeing but to keep it from eating everything in sight.

quotes.name: Thriving Heath
quotes.flavor: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

quotes.name: Arcbound Worker
quotes.flavor: The parts are as strong as the whole.

quotes.name: Storm Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"Embrace the storm. Its voice shall echo within you, and its fire shall become your touch!"
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

quotes.name: Cosmic Crucible
quotes.flavor: "We ignored the risks and the cosmic rays tore through our ship. That's how it all began."

quotes.name: Slither Blade
quotes.flavor: Some naga initiates move as silently as the suns' reflections on the water.

quotes.name: Souls of the Lost
quotes.flavor: "Do you remember us?"

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

quotes.name: Spirit Link
quotes.flavor: The noble paladins draw strength from the courage of others.

quotes.name: Sage of the Inward Eye
quotes.flavor: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

quotes.name: Temple of Enlightenment
quotes.flavor: Once, a symbol of national pride. Now, used only for target practice.

quotes.name: Spawn of Rix Maadi
quotes.flavor:
"Straight from the blood-drenched imagination of our illustrious parun!"
—Nyoser, Gore-House ringleader

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

quotes.name: Glorybringer
quotes.flavor: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.

quotes.name: Naga Vitalist
quotes.flavor: "The lands of the God-Pharaoh are suffused with his breath."

quotes.name: Hawkeye, Avenging Archer
quotes.flavor: "If I miss, it means I've been fooling myself this whole time. So I don't."

quotes.name: Screamreach Brawler
quotes.flavor: "My dragonlord's lightning will dance upon your bones!"

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

quotes.name: Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance
quotes.flavor: When prayers turn to promises, not even fate can stand in their way.

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

quotes.name: Deadly Dispute
quotes.flavor:
"You go break up that bar brawl yet? People are gonna get hurt unless you step in."
—Sheriff Marion

quotes.name: Paradise Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"It contains the wisdom of generations of our people. We permit only a chosen few to don the raiment."
—Imran, Viridian elder

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

quotes.name: Voltaic Construct
quotes.flavor: The undead may outlast the living, but those who have never lived outlast them both.

quotes.name: Rampaging Monument
quotes.flavor: "Be advised: suspect is nine stories tall, marble hair, answers to Saint Gusztav."

quotes.name: Stroke of Midnight
quotes.flavor:
"Who was that knight, so graceful and strong? Why did she flee before the food was gone?"
—*Tale of the Masked Maiden*

quotes.name: Silent-Chant Zubera
quotes.flavor: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

quotes.name: Headless Horseman
quotes.flavor: ". . . The ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head . . . he sometimes passes along the Hollow, like a midnight blast . . ." —Washington Irving, *The Legend of Sleepy Hollow*

quotes.name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
quotes.flavor: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

quotes.name: Rootwater Diver
quotes.flavor:
"Drop a dagger into the murky deep and the merfolk will cut your throat with it."
—Skyshroud saying

quotes.name: Phantasmal Form
quotes.flavor: Within each of us lurks the fathomless.

quotes.name: Caustic Wasps
quotes.flavor: Even the wasp knows how to pay the magistrate his due respect.

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

quotes.name: Dracogenesis
quotes.flavor: Ugin and the dragonstorms of Tarkir are intrinsically linked. With his death they weakened. With his life they raged. But even the Spirit Dragon does not hold them fully under his sway.

quotes.name: Bane's Invoker
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "The Lord of Darkness elevates only those who serve."

quotes.name: Arcane Laboratory
quotes.flavor:
Too many wizards spoil the spell, but too many spells spoil the wizard.
—Sign on entry to arcane lab

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Nylea's Colossus
quotes.flavor:
"Those who seek my protection receive it."
—Nylea, god of the hunt

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Treefolk Harbinger
quotes.flavor: She spreads kindness wherever she goes.

quotes.name: Nightscape Familiar
quotes.flavor: Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.

quotes.name: Circle of Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Boros Challenger
quotes.flavor: "Send your champion. I could use a light workout."

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

quotes.name: Mogg Maniac
quotes.flavor: Stand clear if he gets an itch.

quotes.name: Rent Is Due
quotes.flavor: "You're a month late again, Parker! Give me my money or you're out on the street!"

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor:
"Nature does not need adornment."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Pavel Maliki
quotes.flavor: We all know the legend: Pavel wanders the realms, helping those in greatest need. But is this a measure of his generosity, or of his obligation to atone?

quotes.name: Scourge of Geier Reach
quotes.flavor: Stensian villagers mourned the loss of human life. Thraben vampire slayers mourned the loss of living wood.

quotes.name: Petrify
quotes.flavor: Those who break the laws of the Malamet become cold, silent warnings to others who might try.

quotes.name: Burning Prophet
quotes.flavor: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."

quotes.name: Scale the Heights
quotes.flavor: "Ever onward, ever skyward."

quotes.name: Elusive Tormentor // Insidious Mist
quotes.flavor: Older vampires are usually more cautious than the newly-sired, calling upon ancient magic for which neonates lack patience.

quotes.name: Opposition
quotes.flavor:
"Urza says he's sane. Perhaps, but measures of sanity among planeswalkers are hard to come by."
—Barrin

quotes.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
quotes.flavor: "About, about in reel and rout The death-fires danced at night; The water, like a witch's oils, Burnt green, and blue and white." —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Venomized Cat
quotes.flavor: New York City's rat problem disappeared overnight.

quotes.name: Persist
quotes.flavor:
"I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss. A bit of my soul for a second chance. And I'd do it again, and again—until I had no soul left to trade."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

quotes.name: Chandra's Ignition
quotes.flavor: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

quotes.name: Thrull Champion
quotes.flavor:
"Those idiots should never have bred thrulls for combat!"
—Jherana Rure

quotes.name: Consulate Skygate
quotes.flavor: All skyships entering or leaving the fairgrounds must pass through the security checkpoint.

quotes.name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
quotes.flavor:
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Bubbling Beebles
quotes.flavor:
"Chancellor Rayne canceled the annual beeble roast. I should have married a crueler woman."
—Barrin

quotes.name: Weaver of Lightning
quotes.flavor: "Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."

quotes.name: Sterling Supplier
quotes.flavor: The Sterling Company can always rely on him to bring the thunder.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: No matter how big the fall is, you're safe as long as you land with both feet.

quotes.name: Swampsnare Trap
quotes.flavor:
"Just a little closer. Nice and easy. Nothing to worry about. We just fixin' to eat ya."
—Due, Foggy Swamp Tribe member

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Serpent Specialist
quotes.flavor:
"A wonderful score, my pet. I can't wait to see what we slither away with tomorrow."
—Princess Python, Zelda DuBois

quotes.name: Flowstone Crusher
quotes.flavor:
"What's better than smashing things with a rock? A rock that gets up and smashes things for you."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

quotes.name: Ancient Animus
quotes.flavor: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

quotes.name: Eriette, the Beguiler
quotes.flavor: "Your dreams and mine will soon align."

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Archangel Avacyn // Avacyn, the Purifier
quotes.flavor:
"Wings that once bore hope are now stained with blood. She is our guardian no longer."
—Grete, cathar apostate

quotes.name: Drannith Magistrate
quotes.flavor: "Our sanctuaries must be beacons of reason and calm or else they will fall."

quotes.name: Ancient Hellkite
quotes.flavor: When a dragon attacks, there are no bystanders.

quotes.name: Elvish Mystic
quotes.flavor:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Seal of the Guildpact
quotes.flavor:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Mischievous Poltergeist
quotes.flavor:
"The past is a ghost that haunts you from the moment it exists until the moment you don't."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Demolish
quotes.flavor:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

quotes.name: Oboro, Palace in the Clouds
quotes.flavor: The Brandywine flowed slow and broad before them. A large flat ferry-boat was moored beside the landing.

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Escape Artist
quotes.flavor: "Not even my shadow knows where I am."

quotes.name: Sporemound
quotes.flavor:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

quotes.name: Strip Mine
quotes.flavor: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Tether Technician
quotes.flavor: Konstrari cadets are Hexhaven's front line against any threat, be it Eradian abominations or extradimensional academies.

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"I await your donation."
—Dasha, Orzhov priest

quotes.name: Acquisition Octopus
quotes.flavor: You can never have too many arms.

quotes.name: Estrid's Invocation // Estrid's Invocation
quotes.flavor:
"Purely enchanting. The magic will linger long after you've reached the end."
—Talion, the Kindly Lord

quotes.name: Piracy
quotes.flavor: The sea gives, and the sea takes. Some just help with the taking.

quotes.name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
quotes.flavor: "Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir."

quotes.name: Boldwyr Heavyweights
quotes.flavor: Even if giants bring nothing else on a journey, they bring attention.

quotes.name: Carrion Imp
quotes.flavor: No scrap of nutrition goes to waste in the undercity.

quotes.name: Drown in Sorrow
quotes.flavor:
"The sad truth is that the whip of Erebos is long enough to wrap around all our throats."
—Perisophia the philosopher

quotes.name: Steam Vents
quotes.flavor: The flamekin was drawn toward warm laughter when the skies darkened, then she turned back to the lonely peak.

quotes.name: Tidings
quotes.flavor:
"Though the letter was many pages long, I could tell all I needed to know from one look at the messenger's face."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Poison Dart Frog
quotes.flavor:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

quotes.name: Ashiok's Skulker
quotes.flavor:
"Fear writhes and whispers in the shadows of your mind. It is the enemy you always knew would come."
—Ashiok

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Thorn Elemental
quotes.flavor: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

quotes.name: Caligo Skin-Witch
quotes.flavor: "Take their faces. The lips of these unbelievers may yet honor the Demonlord."

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

quotes.name: Exotic Curse
quotes.flavor:
Fouler than a necromancer's kiss.
—Jamuraan expression

quotes.name: Urban Evolution
quotes.flavor: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

quotes.name: Archon of Redemption
quotes.flavor: Until Emeria is freed, he raises his sword in her name.

quotes.name: Natural End
quotes.flavor: The haunted blade shattered, and the geist drifted gratefully to the Blessed Sleep.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: The Eldrazi may be ruthless, but Zendikar is relentless.

quotes.name: Cloud Elemental
quotes.flavor: The soratami surround their sky-castles with living clouds that serve as both sword and shield.

quotes.name: Mox Amber
quotes.flavor: A moment in time made tangible, it has the power to realize epic visions.

quotes.name: Hungry Flames
quotes.flavor: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

quotes.name: Pentagram of the Ages
quotes.flavor: A mirror, a shield, a promise, a great distance, and a kind word—five ways to avoid harm.

quotes.name: Release the Dogs
quotes.flavor: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

quotes.name: Ardent Elementalist
quotes.flavor: While the Dawnhart witches focus their magic on nature and community, other covens consort with devils and twist the elements to their will.

quotes.name: Renewed Faith
quotes.flavor: "To see gods among the people, part of their daily lives . . . It's inspiring."

quotes.name: Eladamri's Call
quotes.flavor: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Mark of Mutiny
quotes.flavor: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

quotes.name: Ajani's Mantra
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor:
"He hasn't returned to the Cloud Forest. But I can still sense his calming presence."
—Zaliki of Naya

quotes.name: Moment of Heroism
quotes.flavor: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

quotes.name: Mayhem Devil
quotes.flavor: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

quotes.name: Mystic Meditation
quotes.flavor:
"Still the mind and quiet the heart. Only then will you hear the Multiverse's great truths."
—Narset

quotes.name: Hyrax Tower Scout
quotes.flavor: The scouts of Hyrax Tower keep watch at the edge of Setessan territory, protecting the polis from inhuman monsters and enemy armies.

quotes.name: Dregs of Sorrow
quotes.flavor:
"We live for a thousand years. The death of even one brings untold sorrow."
—Elvish elder

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Twenty-seven planets in perfect balance. Come on, that is gorgeous!"
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
quotes.flavor: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."

quotes.name: Teroh's Faithful
quotes.flavor: The light of reason follows them even into battle.

quotes.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
quotes.flavor: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

quotes.name: Roiling Terrain
quotes.flavor:
"The trembling lands ruptured, leaving an open door for things from below to emerge."
—Screed of the Mul Daya

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

quotes.name: Herald of Faith
quotes.flavor: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

quotes.name: Chelonian Tackle
quotes.flavor:
"Scurrids to climb the tower, cervins to cross the stadium, and turtles to win the game."
—Quandrix Mage Tower tactics

quotes.name: Covenant of Minds
quotes.flavor: Before signing anything on Grixis, always read the fine print.

quotes.name: Zodiac Monkey
quotes.flavor: ". . . By six offensives from the hills of Qi Kongming sought to change Han's destiny. . . ."

quotes.name: Yotian Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Time for the Iron Alliance to remind the qadir's army how inhospitable the Sword Marches can be."

quotes.name: Reflector Mage
quotes.flavor: Dressed to suppress.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Goblin Guide
quotes.flavor: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

quotes.name: Rorix Bladewing
quotes.flavor: In an attempt to restore pride to Shiv and to forge an undying legacy, Rorix traveled far to compete for glory in Otaria's Grand Coliseum.

quotes.name: Abzan Falconer
quotes.flavor: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

quotes.name: Geth, Thane of Contracts
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: "It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."

quotes.name: Curse of Shaken Faith
quotes.flavor: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

quotes.name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
quotes.flavor: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

quotes.name: Clever Impersonator
quotes.flavor:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

quotes.name: Nath of the Gilt-Leaf
quotes.flavor: A savage hunter with a prince's bearing.

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: You are drawn to your death as a moth to the flame.

quotes.name: Runeclaw Bear
quotes.flavor: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"If the world turns against me, I will fight as I always have."
—Shadow the Hedgehog

quotes.name: Temple Acolyte
quotes.flavor: Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.

quotes.name: Sheltered Thicket
quotes.flavor:
"History is a burden. Stories can make us fly."
—Robin Hood

quotes.name: Slimy Piper
quotes.flavor: All throughout the glade, sprouts squelched happily along to the tune.

quotes.name: Thought Shucker
quotes.flavor: Many rats have found their minds while lost in the mud-slicked gyre of a snail shell.

quotes.name: Temple of Abandon
quotes.flavor:
"It's my party, and all of me is invited."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Tireless Hauler // Dire-Strain Brawler
quotes.flavor: The new hire proved more than enough to replace the three farmhands who disappeared the week before.

quotes.name: Elementalist Adept
quotes.flavor: "Mana is all around us, ready to take shape. We need only reach out and guide it."

quotes.name: Murder
quotes.flavor:
"Before our final act, I would like to toast all you brave people who joined us tonight to celebrate life . . . and death."
—Maxwell Roth

quotes.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
quotes.flavor: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

quotes.name: Might of Old Krosa
quotes.flavor:
"Krosa the great. Krosa the enduring. Look to the forest, and it will share its bounty."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Stormwild Capridor
quotes.flavor: After a disastrous day of battle, Lavabrink's lightning mages were recalled.

quotes.name: Sandstorm
quotes.flavor: Ravaged by decades of war, the land struck back with primal, blinding fury.

quotes.name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
quotes.flavor: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

quotes.name: Drudge Reavers
quotes.flavor:
"The surface of the land is blanched with salt, but the soil beneath is reddened with death—a fertile ground for necromancy."
—Lim-Dûl the Necromancer

quotes.name: Pianna, Nomad Captain
quotes.flavor: Some find inspiration in their swords. Others find it in their leaders.

quotes.name: Savra, Queen of the Golgari
quotes.flavor: "Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."

quotes.name: Bishop of Wings
quotes.flavor: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."

quotes.name: Werebear
quotes.flavor: To become is to understand.

quotes.name: Allied Teamwork
quotes.flavor: Jet's Freedom Fighters are a dangerous band whose strength lies in three things: their purpose, their numbers, and their bond.

quotes.name: Brokers Veteran
quotes.flavor: One last job before he retires.

quotes.name: Gruul Nodorog
quotes.flavor:
Petting the nodorog
—Gruul expression meaning "making a really big mistake"

quotes.name: Duskfang Mentor
quotes.flavor: "What she sees, I see. What she tastes, I taste."

quotes.name: Oracle's Attendants
quotes.flavor: The future isn't sacred, but its speaker is.

quotes.name: Angelic Wall
quotes.flavor:
"The air stirred as if fanned by angels' wings, and the enemy was turned aside."
—Tales of Ikarov the Voyager

quotes.name: Glamermite
quotes.flavor: "And watch, my queen, he'll do as I please!"

quotes.name: Leonin Vanguard
quotes.flavor: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

quotes.name: Psychotic Fury
quotes.flavor:
"Rage, my servants. Our ancient power is renewed in blood."
—Rakdos

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor: "You go! I'll shield you!"

quotes.name: Silent Arbiter
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

quotes.name: Soul's Majesty
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of wisdom and strength.

quotes.name: Fireblast
quotes.flavor: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

quotes.name: Twins of Maurer Estate
quotes.flavor:
"Children, where are your parents?"
—Reig, wandering monk, last words

quotes.name: Pact of Negation
quotes.flavor: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

quotes.name: Solemnity
quotes.flavor: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.

quotes.name: Whetstone
quotes.flavor:
To hone swords and dull minds.
—Whetstone inscription

quotes.name: Screamreach Brawler
quotes.flavor: "My dragonlord's lightning will dance upon your bones!"

quotes.name: Towering Gibbon
quotes.flavor: "Don't worry, folks. We're perfectly safe here. That's a banana processing plant."

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

quotes.name: Bloodrock Cyclops
quotes.flavor:
"There are only fifty words in the cyclops language, and ten of them mean 'kill.'"
—Ertai

quotes.name: Coastal Tower
quotes.flavor: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

quotes.name: Fortune Teller
quotes.flavor: TODAY'S FORTUNE: YOU WILL REGRET SPENDING YOUR MONEY ON THIS FORTUNE.

quotes.name: Vithian Renegades
quotes.flavor: "Here is the proof that what has been done may yet be undone. The hope we thought dead will be gloriously reborn."

quotes.name: Soulless Jailer
quotes.flavor:
"Lock the door and eat the key."
—Vraan, Executioner Thane

quotes.name: Crooked Custodian
quotes.flavor: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."

quotes.name: Doomed Traveler
quotes.flavor: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

quotes.name: Conifer Strider
quotes.flavor: Atarka's presence thaws the glaciers of Qal Sisma, forcing its elementals to migrate or adapt.

quotes.name: Empress Galina
quotes.flavor: "Above the waves you may be mighty indeed, but down here you belong to me."

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

quotes.name: Vastwood Animist
quotes.flavor: He calls on the forests for counsel and summons the earth to his cause.

quotes.name: Twining Twins // Swift Spiral
quotes.flavor: "We spin and spin to keep us busy, but somehow you're the one who's dizzy."

quotes.name: Scavenger Grounds
quotes.flavor: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

quotes.name: Magmatic Chasm
quotes.flavor: The Needle's Eye, a seldom-used passage that winds through Stensia's mountains, carries travelers close to Ashmouth—too close, some would argue.

quotes.name: Ghostly Changeling
quotes.flavor: In desolate places, changelings may take the shape of fancies, or memories, or fears.

quotes.name: Garruk's Packleader
quotes.flavor:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Searing Light
quotes.flavor:
"Light can lay bare our fears. It can also make them go away."
—Nazra of the Stone Havens

quotes.name: Alchemist's Assistant
quotes.flavor:
"Do not test the mandrill. He knows a thief when he sees one."
—Notice posted at Lu Fen's apothecary

quotes.name: Elven Rite
quotes.flavor: As the bough stretches, so shall you grow. As the roots spread, so shall you thrive.

quotes.name: Relief Captain
quotes.flavor: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

quotes.name: Sphinx's Revelation
quotes.flavor: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

quotes.name: Serrated Biskelion
quotes.flavor:
"Whereas I was created to protect, the biskelion was created to destroy."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Overgrown Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

quotes.name: Furnace Punisher
quotes.flavor: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.

quotes.name: Thundering Tanadon
quotes.flavor:
"We do not need beakers and vials to test our predators."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

quotes.name: Metathran Elite
quotes.flavor: If the eyes are windows to the soul, their souls are not of this world.

quotes.name: Mana Leak
quotes.flavor: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

quotes.name: Vivify
quotes.flavor: Near the Krosan border, farmers keep watch over their fields lest the sod get up and wander away.

quotes.name: Inquisition of Kozilek
quotes.flavor: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

quotes.name: Pack Leader
quotes.flavor: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.

quotes.name: Volcanic Dragon
quotes.flavor: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

quotes.name: Saruli Gatekeepers
quotes.flavor: In Ravnica's wilder districts, nature still stirs, and its protectors still mind their posts.

quotes.name: Bloodgift Demon
quotes.flavor: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

quotes.name: Face Yourself
quotes.flavor:
"I only wish you could see the necessity of this. Your counterparts all have."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Persuasion
quotes.flavor: There's no telling what an accomplished mage might collect.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: Sanguine Sipper
quotes.flavor: The midway offers every flavor under the sun, even to guests who need to stay out of it.

quotes.name: The Spot's Portal
quotes.flavor:
"You've been working too hard, Spider-Man. I think you deserve a little vacation somewhere you won't be so . . . in the way."
—The Spot, Johnathon Ohnn

quotes.name: Tanglebloom
quotes.flavor: Druids converted swaths of the Tangle into tanglebloom orchards. Though heavy tools are needed to cut a leaf in the Tangle, tanglebloom fruit is easily plucked by hand.

quotes.name: Assault Drone
quotes.flavor:
"We have analyzed your defensive capabilities as being unable to withstand us. If you defend yourselves, you will be punished."
—The Borg

quotes.name: Giant Killer // Chop Down
quotes.flavor: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
「効果を抑えるために、呪文の詳細を知る必要ありません。呪文が操作する現実の規則を再配置するだけでいいのです。」
——クアンドルクスの学部長、イムブラハム

quotes.name: Skymarch Bloodletter
quotes.flavor: From the perpetual shadowsmoke that hung above the ship, a silent form emerged, lips curled with malice and anticipation.

quotes.name: Lifelink
quotes.flavor: The spoils of war are not measured only in gold and silver.

quotes.name: Magma Spray
quotes.flavor:
"Jund is a wounded world. Beware its searing blood spilling out onto the surface."
—Rakka Mar

quotes.name: Desperate Stand
quotes.flavor: At the Akroan gates, hoplites revived the tactics of Kytheon Iora's infamous irregulars.

quotes.name: Curse of Opulence
quotes.flavor: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

quotes.name: Return to Dust
quotes.flavor: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

quotes.name: Mutilate
quotes.flavor: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

quotes.name: Havengul Lich
quotes.flavor: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

quotes.name: Makeshift Mannequin
quotes.flavor:
"This vulgar mimicry will end now."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

quotes.name: Weather the Storm
quotes.flavor: "Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."

quotes.name: Axebane Stag
quotes.flavor:
"When the spires have burned and the cobblestones are dust, he will take his rightful place as king of the wilds."
—Kirce, Axebane guardian

quotes.name: Éomer, Marshal of Rohan
quotes.flavor: "Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never."

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."
